text.p: Curtice-Burns Foods, a unit of Pro-Fac Cooperative Inc, Thursday said it will recall all "Tropic Isle" brand fresh frozen coconut produced in Costa Rica due to a health risk.

The product, which is distributed by Curtice Burns unit Southern Frozen Foods of Montezuma, Georgia, was recalled because it may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes, a potentially harmful organism.
The recall was a result of a routine sampling program by Southern Frozen Foods which revealed that the finished product contained the bacteria.
The Tropic Isle coconut in question is packed in 12- and six-ounce polybags and was distributed through retail stores in 30 states.
Curtice Burns it has not received any customer complaints or reports of illnesses.
Southern Frozen Foods has ceased distribution of the product from Costa Rica as the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and the company continue their investigation as to what caused the problem.
